description: Is this request really GPTBot, Googlebot or PerplexityBot? Checks an IP address (and optionally the user agent it sent) against the IP lists OpenAI, Perplexity, DuckDuckGo, Common Crawl, Google, Bing and Apple publish. Says whether the bot is verified, fake (claims a bot but comes from elsewhere), disguised (an AI crawler's address sending a browser user agent) or unverifiable (operator publishes no list, like ClaudeBot), and whether pay-per-crawl would charge it. Free. Free.

ip.description: The request's IP address, IPv4 or IPv6

name: verify_bot
title: Verify a crawler
